description: Add a restrictive exclusion to one alert rule. The autonomous agent may add one only to a test-mode rule, pinned to one IP it verified benign (a client_ip equals condition plus its verificationId); it expires within 7 days. Write action; requires confirmation.

conditions.description: Restrictive exclusion conditions { field, operator, value }. Fields: path, method, user_agent, status_code, request_body, request_headers, client_ip. Pinned to one IP and one route: [{ "field": "client_ip", "operator": "equals", "value": "203.0.113.7" }, { "field": "path", "operator": "starts_with", "value": "/health" }].

confirm.description: Required for write actions. Must be true.

expiresInHours.description: Hours until the exclusion stops applying. Omit for a lasting one; the autonomous agent's always expire within 168 hours (the default).

reason.description: Short human-readable reason for the write action.

verificationId.description: The autonomous agent must pass the verificationId from securenow_agent_verify_ip for the IP the exclusion is pinned to (verdict benign or never_block).

name: securenow_alert_rule_exclusion_add
title: Add Alert Rule Exclusion
